title: Testing Combobox floating behaviour by partially mocking @floating-ui/react
answers: how to test that autoUpdate is not called in Combobox
how to simulate a floating-ui size measurement in jest
test that useComboboxFloat does not rerender
body:
Combobox.test.tsx uses `jest.mock('@floating-ui/react', ...)` and spreads `jest.requireActual`. It wraps `autoUpdate` in `jest.fn` that calls through to the real function. It wraps `size`, saving `options.apply` into a module-level `mockSizeApply`, then returns `actual.size(options)`.
- Get the typed mock with `jest.mocked(autoUpdate)` and call `mockReset()` on it in afterEach.
- To fake a size measurement, call `mockSizeApply?.({ availableWidth, availableHeight })` inside `act()`.
- To detect hidden DOM churn on the input, spy on `HTMLInputElement.prototype.removeAttribute` and assert it was not called with 'name'.
- useComboboxFloat.test.ts fully stubs the module (useFloating returns `{ floatingStyles: {} }`) and counts renders inside `renderHook`.
Always `await user.click(...)`. MultiCombobox.test.tsx had a missing await, which this PR fixed.
